title: उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली नारी–निबन्धमा पृथक् अनुभव–अनुभूति
nepali: नेपाली साहित्यमा चालिसको दशकपछि प्रवृत्तिगत विविधता देखिएको छ । विश्वपरिवेश तथा नेपाली राजनीतिक परिवेशमा देखिएका परिवर्तनको प्रभावस्वरूप साहित्यमा पनि नवीन चिन्तनहरू देखा परेका छन् । त्यसैले यो पछिल्लो अवधिलाई नेपाली साहित्यको उत्तरवर्ती चरण मानिएको छ । यस चरणको साहित्य विशेषगरी पहिचानमुखी पनि देखिन्छ । साहित्यका अन्य विधाहरूमा जस्तै निबन्ध विधाको पनि यो चरण पहिचानका सन्दर्भहरूका आधारमा महत्त्वपूर्ण मानिन्छ । विशेषगरी निबन्ध विधामा नारी स्रष्टाको उपस्थिति तथा उनीहरूका सिर्जनाले गति यसै अवधिमा लिएको पाइन्छ । यस अवधिका नारी निबन्धकारहरूका निबन्धहरूमा नारीवादी चिन्तनले महत्त्पूर्ण स्थान लिएको सन्दर्भमा प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख तयार पारिएको हो ।यसमा नारीवादी सैद्धान्तिक मान्यताका आधारमा उत्तरवर्ती नारी निबन्धहरूको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । नारीवादी मान्यताले जैविकीय आधारमा महिला र पुरुषबिच हुने भिन्नताका कारण महिलाका अनुभव–अनुभूतिहरू पनि पृथक् हुने धारणा राखेको छ । पितृसत्तात्मक सामाजिक संरचना र त्यसद्वारा निर्देशित मूल्यका कारण परिवार तथा समाजमा महिलाका भिन्न भूमिका हुन्छन् र यिनै भूमिकाका आधारमा उनीहरूका अनुभव–अनुभूतिहरू भिन्न हुने धारणा पनि नारीवादीहरूले राखेका छन् । पितृसत्तालाई नारीउत्पीडनको मूल कारक मानेको नारीवादी चिन्तनले सोही उत्पीडनद्वारा सिर्जित भिन्न अनुभव–अनुभूति नारीलिखित साहित्यमा अभिव्यक्त हुने विचार राख्दछ । यसै सन्दर्भमा प्रस्तुत लेखमा नारीवादअन्तर्गत पितृसत्ता, नारीउत्पीडन, नारी–जैविकीय अवस्था तथा पृथक् अनुभव–अनुभूतिसम्बन्धी आधारहरूको चर्चा गरिएको छ । उत्तरवर्ती चरणका नारीलिखित निबन्धहरूमा महिलाका पृथक् अनुभव–अनुभूतिको प्रस्तुतिका प्रशस्त सन्दर्भहरू रहेको निष्कर्ष पनि यस लेखमा निकालिएको छ । उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली नारी–निबन्धमा पितृसत्तात्मक मूल्यभित्र महिलाका पृथक् अनुभव–अनुभुतिको अभिव्यक्तिका केकस्ता सन्दर्भ रहेका छन् भन्ने प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासको समाधान गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार गरिएको प्रस्तुत लेख साहित्यिक भएको हुनाले सोही अनुरूप पुस्तकालयीय कार्यबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरेर विश्लेषणात्मक विधिबाट तिनको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: A diversity of trends has been seen in Nepali literature after the 1940s. As a result of the changes seen in the world environment and the Nepali political environment, new thoughts have also appeared in literature. Therefore, this recent period is considered the later phase of Nepali literature. The literature of this phase is seen to be especially identity-oriented. Just as in other genres of literature, the essay genre in this phase is also considered important on the basis of identity-related contexts. Especially, the presence of women creators in the essay genre and the momentum of their creations are found to have been gained in this very period. In the context that feminist thought has taken an important place in the essays of the women essayists of this period, the present research article has been prepared. In this, based on feminist theoretical tenets, an analysis of the later women's essays has been carried out. Feminist tenets hold the view that women's experiences and feelings also become distinct due to the differences between women and men on a biological basis. Because of the patriarchal social structure and the values directed by it, women have different roles in family and society, and feminists also hold the view that their experiences and feelings become different on the basis of these very roles. Feminist thought, which considers patriarchy the root cause of women's oppression, holds the view that the distinct experiences and feelings created by that very oppression are expressed in women's written literature. In this context, in the present article, under feminism, patriarchy, women's oppression, women's biological condition and foundations related to distinct experiences and feelings have been discussed. The conclusion that there are abundant contexts of the presentation of women's distinct experiences and feelings in the later-phase women's written essays has also been drawn in this article. Because the present article prepared with the objective of resolving the academic curiosity of what kinds of contexts of the expression of women's distinct experiences and feelings within patriarchal values exist in later Nepali women's essays is literary, material has been collected through library work accordingly and those have been analyzed through an analytical method.

informal_english: In Nepali literature, you start seeing a real mix of trends after the 1940s. Because of the changes in the wider world and in Nepali politics, fresh ideas show up in literature too. So this later stretch gets treated as the later phase of Nepali literature. The writing of this phase looks especially identity-focused. In particular, women writers really start making their mark in the essay genre during this period. Given that feminist thinking takes an important place in the essays of the women essayists of this period, this research article was put together. Here, later women's essays are analysed on the basis of feminist theory. Feminist thinking holds that women's experiences and feelings differ too, because of biological differences between women and men. Because of the patriarchal social structure and the values it directs, women have different roles in family and society, and feminists also hold that their experiences and feelings differ on the basis of these very roles. Feminist thought, which treats patriarchy as the root cause of women's oppression, holds that the distinct experiences and feelings created by that oppression find expression in women's writing. In this context, this article discusses patriarchy, women's oppression, women's biological condition and foundations related to distinct experiences and feelings under feminism. It also concludes that there are plenty of contexts of the presentation of women's distinct experiences and feelings in the later-phase women's essays. Because this article, prepared to resolve the academic curiosity of what kinds of contexts of the expression of women's distinct experiences and feelings within patriarchal values exist in later Nepali women's essays, is literary, material was collected through library work accordingly and analysed through an analytical method.
